Supervised Learning এবং Unsupervised Learning এর মধ্যে পার্থক্য উদাহরণসহ আলোচনা করুন।

mustKnow.en: An expert system = knowledge base + inference engine + working memory + user interface + explanation facility (+ knowledge-acquisition module).
mustKnow.bn: Expert system = knowledge base + inference engine + working memory + user interface + explanation facility (+ knowledge-acquisition module)।

mustKnow.en: The knowledge base STORES the rules; the inference engine only REASONS over them (it does not store them).
mustKnow.bn: Knowledge base rule সংরক্ষণ করে; inference engine শুধু তাদের উপর যুক্তি প্রয়োগ করে (সংরক্ষণ করে না)।

mustKnow.en: The inference cycle is match → fire → update → test; firing a rule copies its THEN into working memory.
mustKnow.bn: Inference cycle: match → fire → update → test; rule fire মানে তার THEN working memory-তে কপি করা।

mustKnow.en: Forward chaining = data-driven, bottom-up (XCON); backward chaining = goal-driven, top-down (MYCIN).
mustKnow.bn: Forward chaining = data-driven, bottom-up (XCON); backward chaining = goal-driven, top-down (MYCIN)।

mustKnow.en: DENDRAL = chemistry (molecular structure from a mass spectrum, first expert system); MYCIN = medicine (~600 rules, backward chaining + certainty factors, ~65% correct, never used clinically); XCON = DEC VAX configuration (forward chaining, from 1980).
mustKnow.bn: DENDRAL = রসায়ন (mass spectrum থেকে molecular structure, প্রথম expert system); MYCIN = চিকিৎসা (~৬০০ rule, backward chaining + certainty factor, ~৬৫% সঠিক, ক্লিনিক্যালি ব্যবহৃত হয়নি); XCON = DEC VAX কনফিগারেশন (forward chaining, ১৯৮০ থেকে)।

mustKnow.en: Expert systems do NOT learn; rules are hand-coded, so they suffer the knowledge-acquisition bottleneck and are brittle outside their domain.
mustKnow.bn: Expert system শেখে না; rule হাতে-কোড করা, তাই knowledge-acquisition bottleneck-এ ভোগে ও ডোমেইনের বাইরে ভঙ্গুর।

mustKnow.en: ML ⊂ AI, and deep learning ⊂ ML. A rule-based expert system that never learns is AI but not ML.
mustKnow.bn: ML ⊂ AI, এবং deep learning ⊂ ML। যে rule-based expert system শেখে না তা AI কিন্তু ML নয়।

mustKnow.en: Three ML paradigms: supervised (labelled data), unsupervised (unlabelled data), reinforcement (reward after acting).
mustKnow.bn: তিন ML paradigm: supervised (labelled data), unsupervised (unlabelled data), reinforcement (action-এর পর reward)।

mustKnow.en: Supervised splits into classification (predict a discrete label) and regression (predict a continuous value).
mustKnow.bn: Supervised দুই ভাগ: classification (discrete label predict) ও regression (continuous মান predict)।

mustKnow.en: Unsupervised tasks: clustering (k-means, DBSCAN), dimensionality reduction (PCA), association rules (Apriori).
mustKnow.bn: Unsupervised কাজ: clustering (k-means, DBSCAN), dimensionality reduction (PCA), association rule (Apriori)।

mustKnow.en: Reinforcement learning needs a policy mapping states to actions and maximises cumulative reward (e.g. Q-learning).
mustKnow.bn: Reinforcement learning-এ state→action ম্যাপ করা policy লাগে এবং মোট reward সর্বোচ্চ করে (যেমন Q-learning)।

mustKnow.en: Overfitting = training error ≪ test error (high variance); underfitting = both errors high (high bias).
mustKnow.bn: Overfitting = training error ≪ test error (high variance); underfitting = দুই error-ই বেশি (high bias)।

mustKnow.en: Expected test error = bias² + variance + irreducible noise; more data cuts variance, never bias.
mustKnow.bn: প্রত্যাশিত test error = bias² + variance + irreducible noise; বেশি data variance কমায়, bias নয়।

mustKnow.en: Standard data split is 60/20/20 (train/validation/test); the test set is opened only once, for the final report.
mustKnow.bn: স্ট্যান্ডার্ড data split 60/20/20 (train/validation/test); test set একবারই খোলা হয়, চূড়ান্ত রিপোর্টের জন্য।

mustKnow.en: Accuracy=(TP+TN)/total · Precision=TP/(TP+FP) · Recall(sensitivity)=TP/(TP+FN) · Specificity=TN/(TN+FP) · F1=2PR/(P+R).
mustKnow.bn: Accuracy=(TP+TN)/total · Precision=TP/(TP+FP) · Recall(sensitivity)=TP/(TP+FN) · Specificity=TN/(TN+FP) · F1=2PR/(P+R)।

mustKnow.en: Regression metrics: MAE, MSE, RMSE, R². Recall/precision/F1 are classification metrics, NOT regression metrics.
mustKnow.bn: Regression metric: MAE, MSE, RMSE, R²। Recall/precision/F1 classification metric, regression নয়।

mustKnow.en: Apriori metrics: support(A→B)=P(A∪B); confidence=support(A∪B)/support(A)=P(B|A); lift=confidence/support(B). Lift>1 positive, =1 independent, <1 negative.
mustKnow.bn: Apriori metric: support(A→B)=P(A∪B); confidence=support(A∪B)/support(A)=P(B|A); lift=confidence/support(B)। Lift>1 ধনাত্মক, =1 independent, <1 ঋণাত্মক।

mustKnow.en: Apriori (downward-closure) property: every subset of a frequent itemset is frequent — so any itemset with an infrequent subset is pruned.
mustKnow.bn: Apriori (downward-closure) property: frequent itemset-এর প্রতিটি subset frequent — তাই infrequent subset-যুক্ত itemset ছেঁটে ফেলা হয়।

mustKnow.en: Ensemble: bagging = parallel learners, reduces variance (Random Forest = bagging of trees); boosting = sequential learners fixing earlier errors, reduces bias (AdaBoost).
mustKnow.bn: Ensemble: bagging = সমান্তরাল learner, variance কমায় (Random Forest = tree-র bagging); boosting = ধারাবাহিক learner আগের ভুল শোধরায়, bias কমায় (AdaBoost)।

mustKnow.en: A weak learner is slightly better than random guessing; boosting combines many weak learners into one strong learner.
mustKnow.bn: Weak learner এলোমেলো অনুমানের সামান্য ভালো; boosting অনেক weak learner-কে একটি strong learner-এ পরিণত করে।

mustKnow.en: Decision tree splits on the attribute of highest information gain = H(parent) − Σ(nᵢ/n)·H(childᵢ); entropy H=−Σpᵢlog₂pᵢ (0 pure), Gini=1−Σpᵢ².
mustKnow.bn: Decision tree সর্বোচ্চ information gain-এর attribute-এ split করে = H(parent) − Σ(nᵢ/n)·H(childᵢ); entropy H=−Σpᵢlog₂pᵢ (বিশুদ্ধ হলে 0), Gini=1−Σpᵢ²।

mustKnow.en: k-NN is a supervised, lazy learner (not k-means, which is unsupervised clustering); naive Bayes assumes conditional feature independence.
mustKnow.bn: k-NN একটি supervised, lazy learner (k-means নয়, যা unsupervised clustering); naive Bayes feature-এর conditional independence ধরে নেয়।

formulas.formula: H(S) = −Σ pᵢ log₂ pᵢ ; InfoGain(A) = H(S) − Σ (|Sᵥ|/|S|)·H(Sᵥ)

question.bn: PlayTennis: 14 দিন, 9টি 'yes', 5টি 'no'। H(S) ও Outlook/Humidity/Wind/Temperature-এর কোনটি root তা বের কর।

question.bn: 4টি point-এ error (y−ŷ): +2, −2, +1, −1। MAE ও RMSE বের কর।

example.answer: MAE 1.5, RMSE ≈ 1.58 (RMSE ≥ MAE always; RMSE penalises big errors more).

traps.en: The inference engine does NOT store rules — the knowledge base does; and the explanation facility is NOT the user interface.
traps.bn: Inference engine rule সংরক্ষণ করে না — knowledge base করে; এবং explanation facility ও user interface এক নয়।

traps.en: Do not swap the denominators: precision divides by PREDICTED positives (TP+FP); recall divides by ACTUAL positives (TP+FN).
traps.bn: Denominator অদলবদল করো না: precision ভাগ করে PREDICTED positive (TP+FP) দিয়ে; recall ভাগ করে ACTUAL positive (TP+FN) দিয়ে।

traps.en: F1 is the HARMONIC mean 2PR/(P+R), not the simple average (P+R)/2 — some coaching keys wrongly use the average.
traps.bn: F1 হলো HARMONIC mean 2PR/(P+R), সাধারণ গড় (P+R)/2 নয় — কিছু কোচিং key ভুলভাবে গড় ব্যবহার করে।

traps.en: Accuracy is misleading on imbalanced data: if 99% of cases are negative, 'always negative' scores 99% yet is useless — judge by precision/recall/F1.
traps.bn: Imbalanced data-তে accuracy বিভ্রান্তিকর: 99% case negative হলে 'সবসময় negative' 99% পায় অথচ অকেজো — precision/recall/F1 দিয়ে বিচার কর।

traps.en: k-NN is SUPERVISED (not unsupervised); k-means, DBSCAN and Apriori are unsupervised; a decision tree is supervised.
traps.bn: k-NN SUPERVISED (unsupervised নয়); k-means, DBSCAN ও Apriori unsupervised; decision tree supervised।

traps.en: Lift, not confidence, judges real association: a rule can have high confidence yet lift ≈ 1, meaning no actual association.
traps.bn: প্রকৃত association বিচার করে lift, confidence নয়: একটি rule-এর confidence বেশি অথচ lift ≈ 1 হতে পারে, মানে কোনো প্রকৃত association নেই।

traps.en: 99% training accuracy is NOT success — it often signals overfitting; and more data reduces variance only, never bias.
traps.bn: 99% training accuracy সাফল্য নয় — প্রায়ই overfitting-এর ইঙ্গিত; এবং বেশি data শুধু variance কমায়, bias নয়।

traps.en: DENDRAL was chemistry, not medicine; MYCIN did not learn from patient records; bagging cuts variance while boosting cuts bias — do not swap them.
traps.bn: DENDRAL ছিল রসায়ন, চিকিৎসা নয়; MYCIN রোগীর রেকর্ড থেকে শেখেনি; bagging variance কমায় আর boosting bias — অদলবদল করো না।

bn: Apriori নাম দাও (association-rule mining, unsupervised)
ধাপ: threshold → frequent 1-itemset → candidate join + prune → count → confidence দিয়ে rule, lift দিয়ে rank
তিনটি metric সূত্র লেখ
Worked উদাহরণ {Bread}→{Butter}: support 0.60, confidence 0.75, lift 1.25
lift>1 মানে ধনাত্মক association

5.en: 5-mark: name Apriori + its steps + the three metric definitions.

a.en: A branch of AI in which a system improves its performance on a task by learning patterns from data, instead of following explicitly hand-written rules.
a.bn: AI-এর একটি শাখা যেখানে একটি সিস্টেম স্পষ্ট হাতে-লেখা rule অনুসরণের বদলে data থেকে pattern শিখে কোনো কাজে তার performance উন্নত করে।

q.en: What is deep learning, and how does it differ from traditional ML?
q.bn: Deep learning কী, এবং প্রচলিত ML থেকে কীভাবে ভিন্ন?

a.en: Deep learning is ML using multi-layer neural networks that learn features automatically from raw data; traditional ML usually relies on hand-engineered features and needs less data and compute.
a.bn: Deep learning হলো বহু-স্তর neural network ব্যবহারকারী ML যা raw data থেকে feature নিজে শেখে; প্রচলিত ML সাধারণত হাতে-বানানো feature-এর উপর নির্ভর করে ও কম data ও compute লাগে।

q.en: Supervised vs unsupervised learning in one line?
q.bn: এক লাইনে supervised বনাম unsupervised learning?

a.en: Supervised learns from labelled (X, y) data to predict a known output; unsupervised finds structure in unlabelled data (e.g. clustering).
a.bn: Supervised labelled (X, y) data থেকে জানা output predict করতে শেখে; unsupervised unlabelled data-তে গঠন খুঁজে বের করে (যেমন clustering)।

a.en: When a model fits the training data so closely that it learns its noise, scoring high on training data but poorly on unseen data (high variance).
a.bn: যখন model training data-কে এত ঘনিষ্ঠভাবে fit করে যে তার noise শিখে ফেলে, training data-তে বেশি কিন্তু অদেখা data-তে খারাপ score পায় (high variance)।

q.en: What does the inference engine of an expert system do?
q.bn: Expert system-এর inference engine কী করে?

a.en: It reasons over the knowledge base, matching rules against the facts in working memory and firing those that apply (match → fire → update → test); it does not store the rules.
a.bn: এটি knowledge base-এর উপর যুক্তি প্রয়োগ করে, working memory-র fact-এর বিপরীতে rule মেলায় ও প্রযোজ্যগুলো fire করে (match → fire → update → test); rule সংরক্ষণ করে না।

q.en: Precision vs recall — what is the difference?

a.en: Precision = TP/(TP+FP) is how many flagged positives were truly positive; recall = TP/(TP+FN) is how many actual positives were caught. Precision divides by predicted positives, recall by actual positives.
a.bn: Precision = TP/(TP+FP) হলো flagged positive-এর কতগুলো সত্যিই positive; recall = TP/(TP+FN) হলো actual positive-এর কতগুলো ধরা পড়ল। Precision ভাগ করে predicted positive দিয়ে, recall actual positive দিয়ে।
